description: Cagey: gives the opponent nothing, and would rather carry deadwood than feed a meld.

take_upcard.instructions: Would taking `upcard` tell the opponent more about `me.hand` than the improvement to `me.deadwood` is worth?

knock_now.instructions: Given `me.can_knock` and what `opponent.discarded` suggests they are holding, should I end the hand now before they can, or play on?

opponent_is_close.instructions: From `opponent.discarded` (oldest first), `opponent.took_from_discard` and `stock.drawn_so_far`, how close is the opponent to being able to knock?
criteria: Far from knocking: still throwing high cards, with no melds evident.
Building melds, but likely still holding a lot of deadwood.
Could plausibly knock within the next two or three turns.
Able to knock now or on the next turn.

discard_choice.instructions: Which of `candidates` should I throw this turn? Choose the card the opponent is least likely to want, judged from `opponent.discarded` and `opponent.took_from_discard`, even when `candidates` shows another slot is cheaper. Answer with the slot number.

criteria.0: The card in `candidates[0]`, whose exact cost is `candidates[0].deadwood_after`.
criteria.1: The card in `candidates[1]`, whose exact cost is `candidates[1].deadwood_after`.
criteria.2: The card in `candidates[2]`, whose exact cost is `candidates[2].deadwood_after`.
criteria.3: The card in `candidates[3]`, whose exact cost is `candidates[3].deadwood_after`.

criteria.6: The card in `candidates[6]`, whose exact cost is `candidates[6].deadwood_after`.
criteria.7: The card in `candidates[7]`, whose exact cost is `candidates[7].deadwood_after`.
criteria.8: The card in `candidates[8]`, whose exact cost is `candidates[8].deadwood_after`.

criteria.10: The card in `candidates[10]`, whose exact cost is `candidates[10].deadwood_after`.
